constraints.reason: Keep repository-local use available without mandatory package installation.
constraints.rule: Core CLI commands must run with the Python standard library only.
verification: Install and run the core CLI with optional dependencies absent.

constraints.reason: Core commands must remain usable when MCP support is not installed.
constraints.rule: MCP server mode must degrade gracefully when the optional mcp package is missing.
verification: Verify cmd_mcp returns a clear installation error when imports fail.

constraints.reason: Rollback must never discard user source changes.
constraints.rule: Rollback may restore generated map projections only and must never revert source code.
verification: Confirm rollback touches only PROJECT_MAP.md and PROJECT_MAP.min.md.

constraints.reason: Windows CP1252 terminals otherwise fail on diagnostic Unicode output.
constraints.rule: CLI stdout and stderr must use UTF-8 with replacement-safe error handling.
verification: Run CLI diagnostics under a non-UTF-8 Windows console.
